name: Salesforce
does: Enterprise CRM platform (Sales Cloud) with the largest integration ecosystem in the category.
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 web-server + JWT-bearer flows; connected apps issue client id/secret.
gate_detail: Free Developer Edition org is self-serve; create a connected app inside it for client credentials. Production orgs are sales-led, but the developer path is open.
breadth: Huge: REST + SOAP + Bulk v2 + Streaming + Platform Events + Metadata API

name: HubSpot
does: All-in-one CRM + marketing hub (contacts, deals, email, automation).
auth_detail: OAuth2 for public apps; private-app access tokens for server-to-server.
gate_detail: Free CRM tier is self-serve; create a private app token or register a public app instantly.
breadth: Very broad: CRM objects, marketing events, workflows, files, webhooks (~150+ endpoints)

name: Pipedrive
does: Sales CRM for SMBs with visual pipelines.
auth_detail: Per-user API token (simple) or OAuth2 for marketplace apps.
gate_detail: 14-day trial self-serve; API token visible in personal settings right away.
breadth: Broad CRUD: deals, persons, activities, notes, webhooks (~100 endpoints)

name: Attio
does: Real-time collaborative CRM with a highly customizable data model (objects, attributes, lists) for GTM teams.
auth_detail: API key (workspace token) or OAuth2; both sent as Authorization: Bearer, Basic also accepted; same scope model for both.
gate_detail: Generate a workspace API key instantly in developer/workspace settings; OAuth apps created in the developer console. Docs mention a free-usage path but exact plan gating of API not re-verified.
breadth: Full CRUD across records, objects, attributes, lists, comments, notes, tasks, meetings, emails, webhooks + OAuth endpoints + read-only SQL (particle SQL); tiered per-workspace rate limits.
notes: Official hosted MCP at mcp.attio.com/mcp (OAuth, ~40 tools; SQL tool gated by billing plan). Platform = App SDK + REST API + MCP + SQL.

name: Twenty
does: Open-source, self-hostable 'AI-native' CRM positioned as the open alternative to Salesforce.
auth_detail: API keys (per workspace) plus OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE, client-credentials for server-to-server).
gate_detail: Open-source core self-hostable instantly at no cost; Cloud workspaces also self-serve signup. Exact Cloud plan needed for API/MCP not verified.
breadth: REST and GraphQL APIs auto-generated from the workspace schema (full CRUD), webhooks on record changes, plus an Apps framework (React apps, server logic, agents/skills - alpha).
notes: twenty.com FAQ: 'Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth.' Many community MCP servers also exist.

name: Podio
does: Low-code collaborative work-management platform with customizable 'apps' and workspaces (owned by Progress).
auth_detail: OAuth2 with 4 flows: server-side, client-side, username/password (last resort), app-authentication (acts on one Podio app without a user); access token 8h, refresh 28d.
gate_detail: Register an API application (client id/secret) with any Podio account; a Free plan ($0, up to 5 users) exists per Progress pricing page, so key creation is instant.
breadth: Broad legacy REST API (orgs, spaces, apps, items, tasks, files, contacts, webhooks) with official client libraries; API call-capacity upgrades are a paid add-on ($23/mo+).
blocker: Legacy API, 8-hour OAuth tokens, no first-party MCP
notes: No first-party MCP; only community/third-party servers. podio.com/pricing now 301-redirects to progress.com.

name: Zoho CRM
does: Zoho's CRM suite (sales force automation, omni-channel).
auth_detail: OAuth2 with self-registered clients; refresh tokens long-lived.
gate_detail: Free plan + self-serve API client registration via api-console.zoho.com.
breadth: Broad: modules CRUD, bulk read/write, related lists, webhooks

name: Close
does: CRM for SMB sales teams with built-in calling, email and sales sequences.
auth_detail: API key used as the HTTP Basic username with empty password (apikey:); OAuth2 offered for user-facing integrations.
gate_detail: Create/manage API keys in Settings > Developer > API Keys; no plan requirement stated (paid product; trial signup gets you in).
breadth: Full CRUD: leads, contacts, activities, sequences, email bulk actions, custom fields, events, reporting metrics, webhooks with 30-day event log; interactive explorer + community libraries.
notes: Official hosted MCP (HTTP Streamable, OAuth dynamic client registration, or API-key headers with mcp.read/write scopes); official connector in Claude, ChatGPT plugin, Cursor.

name: Copper
does: Google-friendly CRM (works inside Gmail) for SMB sales teams.
auth_detail: Integration tokens (Bearer) or OAuth2 for marketplace apps.
gate_detail: 14-day trial self-serve; generate integration token in settings.
breadth: Broad CRUD: leads, opportunities, activities, users, webhooks

name: DealCloud
does: Intapp DealCloud - financial-services CRM/deal and relationship-management platform for capital markets, PE and advisory firms.
auth_detail: API key generated from a user's profile, plus a separate 'Authorization Token' mechanism; legacy C#/Python SDKs document their own auth. No OAuth2 found.
gate_detail: An admin must enable the 'API' site-area capability for the user's group (Admin > User Management); the user then copies their key from their profile. Org must be an enterprise DealCloud customer (procurement via Intapp sales) - no self-serve instance.
breadth: Wide: Schema APIs, Data APIs (cells/rows CRUD, upsert, history, files, merge), User Management, real-time Publications/events, Site Backups, Relationship Intelligence; Python SDK (beta), C# SDK.
blocker: Enterprise procurement plus admin-gated API enablement
notes: Official MCP section at api.docs.dealcloud.com/mcp; a third-party writeup calls it client-preview starting July 2026 - preview status not stated on the docs landing page.

name: Zendesk
does: Customer-service suite (ticketing, help center, chat, voice).
auth_detail: API token with HTTP Basic (email/token) or OAuth2 for apps.
gate_detail: Self-serve trial; enable token access in admin settings (you are the admin on a trial).
breadth: Very broad: tickets, users, orgs, macros, views, chat, voice, webhooks

name: Intercom
does: Customer-messaging platform (inbox,Fin AI agent, outbound).
auth_detail: Access tokens (Bearer) or OAuth2 for public apps.
gate_detail: 14-day trial self-serve; create access token in developer hub.
breadth: Broad: contacts, conversations, tickets, data events, news

name: Freshdesk
does: Freshworks' helpdesk (tickets, Freddy AI, self-service).
auth_detail: Per-account API key as Basic auth (key:X).
gate_detail: Free plan available; API key shown in profile settings instantly.
breadth: Broad: tickets, contacts, companies, agents, solutions, Canned Responses

name: Front
does: Shared-inbox customer-communications platform (email, SMS, chat, social in collaborative queues).
auth_detail: Bearer API tokens (created in settings) or OAuth2; 'OAuth is required for public integrations available to all Front customers' unless exempted; tokens carry feature/namespace/read-write scopes incl. an MCP-server scope.
gate_detail: Free developer account available (limited to 3 teammates); API tokens created self-serve in settings; publishing public apps goes through the App Store process.
breadth: Core API is the primary backend API - full CRUD from Contacts to Comments to Tags, conversations/messages, channels, webhooks, analytics export; plus Channels API, Plugin SDK, Connectors.
notes: Official MCP Server documented (lets Claude/ChatGPT read and reply to conversations); dev.front.com does not resolve - docs live at dev.frontapp.com.

name: Pylon
does: Agentic B2B customer-support platform tracking issues across Slack Connect, email, Teams, chat widgets and forms.
auth_detail: Bearer API token generated in the dashboard (app.usepylon.com/settings/api-tokens); region-specific base URLs; actions attributed to the token's name.
gate_detail: Token creation is self-serve once you have a workspace, but Pylon is sales-led: no public pricing and no 'Sign up / Start free trial' CTA observed (usepylon.com and /pricing are demo-booking only, Sep 2026).
breadth: REST API reference covering issues, messages, accounts, contacts, users, etc. with webhooks and error handling; exact endpoint count not enumerated in fetched pages.
blocker: Workspace requires sales-led onboarding (no public pricing/self-serve signup)
notes: Official MCP at mcp.usepylon.com (OAuth/AuthKit, 11 read/write tools, requires 'MCP Access' role).

name: LiveAgent
does: Helpdesk/ticketing platform (live chat, ticketing, call center) by QualityUnit.
auth_detail: API key passed as apikey query parameter (GET) or form field (POST); agent-level auth tokens for SSO.
gate_detail: API key generated inside the app (Configuration > System > API & Integrations); LiveAgent has a free plan/trial. Whether every plan tier includes full API access was not verified.
breadth: API v1: agents, companies, conversations, customers, files, knowledgebase, reports (SLA, performance), tags; JSON/XML formats, some endpoints version-gated.
blocker: Legacy v1 API (keys in query strings, form-encoded writes)
notes: developers.liveagent.com DNS dead - reference lives on support portal; shipped built-in MCP server in v5.63 (May 2026) for Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai, FlowHunt.

name: Plain
does: API-first B2B support platform with a single shared queue (email, Slack, Teams, Discord, chat) and AI agents.
auth_detail: API keys belonging to machine users: Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_...; multiple keys per machine user for rotation, fine-grained per-key permissions; request signing and mTLS documented for some flows.
gate_detail: Create machine users and API keys yourself in Settings > Machine Users (keys shown once). Plain workspace acquisition path (self-serve vs sales) not independently verified.
breadth: Single GraphQL API with full platform parity ('Everything the app can do, the GraphQL API can do') - threads, customers, tenants, machine users, API keys, agents/skills; no REST API in docs.
notes: Official MCP at mcp.plain.com/mcp (OAuth as your user, 30 tools). developer.plain.com does not resolve; docs at plain.com/docs.

name: Help Scout
does: Help desk for SMBs (shared inbox + customer profiles).
auth_detail: Per-user API key (Bearer), OAuth2 for apps.
gate_detail: 15-day trial self-serve; API key in settings immediately.
breadth: Moderate: customers, conversations, mailboxes, docs, reports, webhooks

name: Gorgias
does: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk built on Shopify data (tickets with order context).
auth_detail: OAuth2 for apps; per-user API tokens also issued.
gate_detail: Trial signup self-serve (Shopify-adjacent); token in settings after signup.
breadth: Moderate: conversations, customers, events, fields, webhooks

name: Gladly
does: Customer-service platform organized around people (customer-level conversations) across voice, email, chat, SMS, WhatsApp and social.
auth_detail: HTTP Basic over HTTPS: agent email as username, API token as password; tokens shown once, rotation documented.
gate_detail: Sales-led product - no self-serve signup, no public pricing (gladly.ai/pricing is demo-only). Within an org, an admin must grant a user the 'API User' permission before that user can create a token.
breadth: Broad: agents, conversations, communications (send SMS/email), customers, topics, inboxes, teams, events, JSONL data exports, reports, webhooks, plus a Lookup API and a .gladly.qa sandbox.
blocker: Sales-led access plus admin-granted API User permission
notes: No MCP server mentioned in the developer docs. Gladly.com now redirects to gladly.ai.

name: Slack
does: Team chat platform (channels, huddles, workflow automation).
auth_detail: Bot/user tokens (xoxb/xoxp) via OAuth2 install flow; app-level tokens.
gate_detail: Create an app and install to a free workspace in minutes at api.slack.com.
breadth: Very broad: chat, conversations, users, files, admin, workflows + Events API + Socket Mode

name: Twilio
does: CPaaS: SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email, verify APIs.
auth_detail: Account SID + auth token (Basic) or API keys; signing keys for webhooks.
gate_detail: Free trial account with credit is self-serve; instant credentials.
breadth: Very broad: messaging, voice, video, verify, lookup, studio

name: Zoho Cliq
does: Team chat/communication app in the Zoho workplace suite (channels, messages, bots, meetings).
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 via Zoho API Console (api-console.zoho.com); requests use 'Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <token>'; client types include server-based, client-based, mobile-based, non-browser and self-client; multi-DC endpoints.
gate_detail: Register a client in the Zoho API Console, receive client ID/secret immediately; docs mention no cost or approval step for API registration.
breadth: Broad: v2/v3 REST covering users/orgs, chats, messages, threads, channels, scheduled messages, reminders, bots, meetings/calendar, files, bulk export, message components; OpenAPI spec + Postman collection.
notes: Zoho's official MCP platform page lists Zoho Cliq among connected apps; help.zoho.com KB pages are JS-rendered, so Cliq MCP detail rests on the fetched zoho.com/mcp/ page.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
does: Collaboration suite (chat, docs, calendar, mail) with a large open-platform API; international counterpart of Feishu.
auth_detail: Server APIs authenticate with app_access_token/tenant_access_token obtained via app_id + app_secret from the open-platform console; user-context calls use OAuth 2.0 user_access_token (official lark-openapi-mcp supports both).
gate_detail: Create an app free at open.larksuite.com developer console to get app_id/app_secret; publishing to the Lark App Store or using many advanced scopes requires permission application / app release review - the main friction for third-party agents.
breadth: Very broad: hundreds of server-side REST APIs (IM, docs, calendar, contacts, HR, approval, sheets) plus webhooks/Event subscriptions; no public GraphQL.
blocker: Scope approval / app release review for many APIs
notes: open.larksuite.com docs are a fully client-rendered SPA (200 but empty shell), so auth/gate facts were confirmed via the official larksuite GitHub org README.

name: Pumble
does: Team chat app by CAKE.com (channels, threads, DMs, calls) with an app/addon marketplace.
auth_detail: The official 'API' addon issues workspace API keys for simple HTTP requests ('without any complex authentication processes'); marketplace apps built on the CAKE.com dev platform act as an authorized user or workspace bot.
gate_detail: Install the API addon in your workspace and click Add API key; help docs state 'Available on all plans' (free plan exists); rate limit ~1000 req/min/user; self-serve app creation with a developer account.
breadth: Moderate: send/delete messages, replies, reactions, channel creation, list channels/DMs, user groups; broader via the marketplace app platform (events/triggers, webhooks, blocks).
notes: Official page pumble.com/mcp 'Connect AI agents with the Pumble MCP' (fetched, 200); community servers also exist.

name: Discord
does: Chat/voice communities platform (servers, bots, rich presence).
auth_detail: Bot tokens (Bearer) via developer portal; OAuth2 for user apps.
gate_detail: Create a bot instantly in the developer portal; free.
breadth: Broad for platform control: channels, messages, guilds, interactions, voice

name: Telegram
does: Messaging app with a free Bot API and a paid gateway for business messaging.
auth_detail: Bot API: token in URL/Bearer. Telegram Business API: separate access token.
gate_detail: Bot token from @BotFather instantly, free. Business/gateway access is a separate application.
breadth: Broad for bots: messages, updates, inline mode, payments, web apps

name: WhatsApp Business
does: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) for business messaging at scale.
auth_detail: System-user access tokens (Bearer) via Meta Business; app secret for webhooks (HMAC).
gate_detail: Requires Meta Business verification + app review for higher tiers; a dev can start on a test number self-serve, but production sends need business verification.
breadth: Moderate: messages, templates, phone numbers, webhooks
blocker: Business verification + app review before production sends

name: Aircall
does: Cloud business phone system (voice/WhatsApp) with a developer platform: REST API, webhooks, AI APIs, embed SDK.
auth_detail: Primary for own integrations: Basic Authentication with an API ID + token generated in the Aircall Dashboard; OAuth required when acting on behalf of other Aircall customers (public/marketplace apps).
gate_detail: API keys require an Aircall account (paid product; trial signup); publishing public apps (or registering a public MCP) requires acceptance into Aircall's tech partner program and review.
breadth: Moderate-broad: calls, contacts, users, WhatsApp messaging, analytics reports, outbound AI-agent call triggers, conversation trackers, webhooks, embed SDK; docs have llms.txt and per-page .md.
blocker: Paid account required (and partner review for public/MCP apps)
notes: Aircall's MCP story is inverted vs most apps: it consumes YOUR MCP servers for its AI Virtual Agents rather than exposing an official 'Aircall API MCP server'.

name: Vonage
does: CPaaS: SMS, Voice, Video, Messages, Verify, Number Insight and conversation APIs.
auth_detail: API key + secret as HTTP Basic (base64) or header parameters; newer APIs (Voice, Video, Messages, Verify, Conversation) use JWTs (RS256) signed with an application ID + private key.
gate_detail: Account creation auto-generates an API key/secret in the Vonage Dashboard; JWT apps self-serve via dashboard or CLI; no approval process.
breadth: Very broad: messaging (SMS/MMS/WhatsApp), Voice (NCCO), Video, Verify v2, Number Insight, Conversation, media, subaccounts; official SDKs in many languages.
notes: Official MCP servers are docs/tooling assistants (search docs, generate code) - they do not expose your Vonage account APIs via MCP; API-key/secret and JWT auth still required for account actions.

name: Google Ads
does: Google's paid-search advertising API (campaigns, ads, bidding, reporting).
auth_detail: OAuth2 service accounts or user flows; Google Ads developer token required on top.
gate_detail: Developer token requires an application (basic access granted after review) tied to a manager account; test accounts are instant.
breadth: Huge (gRPC/REST): campaigns, criteria, ads, bidding, change events, GAQL reporting

name: Meta Ads
does: Meta's advertising API (Facebook/Instagram campaigns, audiences, insights).
auth_detail: Facebook Login OAuth2; system-user tokens for servers; appsecret_proof HMAC recommended.
gate_detail: Basic access self-serve; advanced access needs App Review + business verification by an admin.
breadth: Very broad: ad accounts, campaigns, insights, audiences, catalog
blocker: App review + business verification for advanced access

name: LinkedIn Ads
does: LinkedIn's paid-campaigns API (sponsored content, audiences, reporting).
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 3-legged; member + app permissions on top.
gate_detail: Marketing API product access requires an approved LinkedIn app (application review) plus ad-account admin.
breadth: Broad: ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, audience segments, analytics
blocker: Marketing API product access is application-gated

name: GoHighLevel
does: All-in-one white-label CRM/marketing SaaS for agencies (contacts, conversations, funnels, calendars, payments) with REST API and marketplace apps.
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 for marketplace apps (short-lived scoped access/location tokens), or Private Integration Tokens (PITs) for own/private integrations; both bearer-style against api.gohighlevel.com / services.leadconnectorhq.com.
gate_detail: Requires a HighLevel account (no permanent free tier; 14-day trial commonly offered); PITs created by an agency/location admin under Settings > Private Integrations; public marketplace apps pass HighLevel's app approval.
breadth: Broad CRM surface: contacts, conversations, opportunities/pipelines, calendars/appointments, payments/invoices, users/locations, custom fields, webhooks; OpenAPI reference on Stoplight with SDKs.
notes: Both docs portals are JS-rendered SPAs (200 but no server-rendered body), so auth detail was extracted from meta/inline text in the fetched marketplace docs HTML; official MCP server guide exists in the help center (Jul 2026).

name: Mailchimp
does: Email-marketing/ESP platform (audiences, campaigns, automation).
auth_detail: API key (Basic user:key) or OAuth2 for apps.
gate_detail: Free tier self-serve; API key in account extras instantly.
breadth: Broad: lists, members, campaigns, automations, reports (Marketing + Transactional split)

name: Klaviyo
does: Customer data + marketing automation platform (ecommerce-focused).
auth_detail: Private API keys (Basic) with scopes; OAuth2 added for partner apps.
gate_detail: Free tier self-serve; create private key in settings instantly.
breadth: Very broad: profiles, events, campaigns, metrics, segments, catalogs, reporting

name: systeme.io
does: All-in-one funnel builder / marketing platform (contacts, tags, funnels, email campaigns, courses, payments).
auth_detail: Single scheme: 'X-API-Key' header with a Public API key generated in dashboard profile settings ('Public API keys' / 'MCP & API keys'); server-side use only; the MCP server authenticates with its own MCP key.
gate_detail: Generate API keys and MCP keys directly in your account profile settings (self-serve); systeme.io has a free plan - whether API/MCP keys are restricted to paid tiers could not be confirmed from docs.
breadth: Moderate: contacts, tags, contact fields, funnels + steps, campaigns/newsletters, SMS templates, communities, courses, payments, domains, files, webhooks, automation rules; cursor pagination.
blocker: MCP server is initial release with limited capabilities
notes: Surprisingly good agent story for a funnel builder: ReadMe-style docs with llms.txt/.md, official MCP server (beta) covering contacts/tags/newsletters.

name: Pinterest
does: Pinterest API v5 (pins, boards, ad campaigns, analytics).
auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 access tokens with scopes; ad-account scoping.
gate_detail: Developer account + app creation self-serve; instant access to v5 read/write basics.
breadth: Moderate: boards, pins, media, ad accounts, campaigns, analytics

name: Threads (Meta)
does: Meta's Threads text/social app API for creators and brands to publish posts and manage presence at scale.
auth_detail: Threads user access tokens via the Authorization Window: short-lived (1h) tokens exchangeable to long-lived 60-day tokens; permissions scoped per app+user (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, threads_manage_replies, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_insights).
gate_detail: Free self-serve app creation in the Meta App Dashboard (Threads API use case); testing only with invited app 'testers'; for public users every permission must pass Meta's App Review and the app must be published.
breadth: Narrow-moderate: publish single/carousel threads, media/profiles, read/manage replies, moderation, insights, webhooks, keyword search, oEmbed; Graph-style endpoints, no GraphQL.
blocker: App Review required for each permission
notes: No official Meta MCP server found in Meta's docs or changelog; multiple community/third-party MCP servers exist (npm, glama.ai, mcpservers.org).

name: SendGrid
does: Email delivery API (transactional send + email marketing via Twilio SendGrid).
auth_detail: Bearer API keys with granular permissions.
gate_detail: Free tier self-serve; create API key immediately after signup.
breadth: Broad: mail send, templates, contacts, campaigns, suppressions, inbound parse

name: Shopify
does: Leading hosted-ecommerce platform (storefront + admin APIs, apps).
auth_detail: Admin API access tokens for custom apps (created in dev dashboard); OAuth2 for public apps; storefront tokens for Storefront API.
gate_detail: Partner account + free development store is self-serve; custom-app token issued instantly inside the store admin.
breadth: Very broad: Admin REST+GraphQL, Storefront GraphQL, webhooks, functions

name: WooCommerce
does: Open-source ecommerce plugin for WordPress (the WooCommerce REST API).
auth_detail: Consumer key/secret over HTTPS (Basic) or OAuth 1.0a for non-HTTPS.
gate_detail: Self-host or WordPress.com - plugin is free; generate keys in WP admin (you are the admin).
breadth: Broad CRUD: products, orders, customers, coupons, reports, webhooks

name: BigCommerce
does: SaaS headless-commerce platform ( storefront + catalog + checkout APIs).
auth_detail: API accounts -> OAuth2 client-credentials token, or store API tokens (Basic/acst).
gate_detail: Free trial self-serve; create API account/credentials in store settings.
breadth: Broad: catalog (v3 REST + GraphQL), orders, customers, themes, webhooks

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
does: Open-source commerce platform (Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source).
auth_detail: Integration access tokens (Bearer), OAuth2 for apps, session/key pairs for admin.
gate_detail: Free open-source edition self-hostable; admin creates an integration token (you are the admin).
breadth: Broad: catalog, inventory, orders, customers + GraphQL storefront APIs

name: Squarespace
does: Website builder with commerce; REST API covers core commerce objects.
auth_detail: Single API key (Bearer) per site.
gate_detail: API access requires a paid (Business+) site plan; key generated in site settings.
breadth: Narrow: products, inventory, orders, transactions, webhooks
blocker: Narrow API scope, paid plan required

name: Amazon Selling Partner
does: Amazon's unified API for selling partners (orders, listings, finance, FBA).
auth_detail: Login-with-Amazon OAuth2 + AWS SigV4 (IAM role) for most endpoints.
gate_detail: Requires a Professional seller account ($39.99/mo, self-serve) then self-registered app (LWA credentials) - or vendor status for Vendor APIs.
breadth: Very broad: orders, inventory, pricing, FBA, finance, reports, notifications

name: DataForSEO
does: SEO data API provider (SERPs, keywords, backlinks, domain analytics) - pay-as-you-go.
auth_detail: login:password as HTTP Basic header over HTTPS.
gate_detail: Self-serve signup; API access needs a minimum deposit ($ min balance) then pay-per-request.
breadth: Very broad: SERP API, Keywords, DataForSEO Labs, Backlinks, Domain Analytics, On-Page, Content Analysis

name: Ahrefs
does: SEO intelligence suite (backlink index, keywords, site audit); official API access is restricted.
auth_detail: API key/token for API v3/v2 endpoints.
gate_detail: Public API v3 access is partner/enterprise-gated (application + sales conversation); the product UI is self-serve but the API is not.
breadth: Broad where accessible: site explorer, keywords explorer, backlinks (v3 units-based)
blocker: API access partner-gated; product plans do not include open API

name: Apify
does: Web-scraping/automation platform (Actors) with storage, proxies, scheduling.
auth_detail: Personal access tokens (Bearer) with per-token permissions.
gate_detail: Free tier with platform credits; token in console instantly.
breadth: Very broad: actors run/input/dataset API, key-value store, schedules, webhooks, log

name: Firecrawl
does: Web-scraping API for LLMs (crawl, scrape, extract to markdown/structured).
auth_detail: Bearer API key.
gate_detail: Free tier with credits, self-serve dashboard, instant key.
breadth: Focused but deep: scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, v2 agents SDK

name: Bright Data
does: Web-data platform: proxies, Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraping browser, datasets.
auth_detail: Account token (Bearer) + zone-level proxy credentials.
gate_detail: Self-serve signup with card/minimum deposit for API products; instant credentials.
breadth: Broad across products: unlocker, serp, scraper browser control, datasets

name: Clay
does: Data-intelligence/spreadsheet platform (enrichment, waterfalls, AI agents in Clay).
auth_detail: OAuth2 for public apps; per-user API keys for private API use.
gate_detail: Self-serve signup but paid plans; API access tied to plan credits.
breadth: Moderate: tables, rows, enrichment runs, webhooks (public API subset of product)
blocker: API subset of a heavy product; plan-gated usage

name: GitHub
does: Code hosting + collaboration platform (repos, PRs, issues, actions).
auth_detail: PATs (Bearer/Basic), GitHub App installation JWT + tokens, OAuth2 for user apps.
gate_detail: Free account; fine-grained PAT or GitHub App self-serve instantly.
breadth: Huge: repos, PRs, issues, actions, packages, orgs (~500+ REST endpoints + GraphQL)

name: Vercel
does: Frontend cloud platform (deployments, domains, serverless functions).
auth_detail: Access tokens (Bearer); OAuth2 for apps.
gate_detail: Free Hobby tier self-serve; create token in account settings instantly.
breadth: Broad: projects, deployments, domains, DNS, env vars, webhooks + mgmt SDK

name: Netlify
does: Netlify hosting/build platform (sites, deploys, functions, forms).
auth_detail: Personal access tokens (Bearer) or OAuth2 for apps.
gate_detail: Free tier self-serve; PAT created instantly.
breadth: Broad: sites, deploys, functions, forms, split tests, webhooks

name: Cloudflare
does: Edge/network/security platform (DNS, zones, workers, WAF, R2, KV).
auth_detail: Scoped API tokens (Bearer); user tokens; mTLS options; OAuth2 for some flows.
gate_detail: Free plan self-serve; scoped tokens created instantly in dash.
breadth: Huge: zones, DNS, workers, KV, R2, WAF, rulesets (~1000+ endpoints)

name: Supabase
does: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions.
auth_detail: Anon + service_role JWT keys for data APIs; PAT/OAuth2 for management API.
gate_detail: Free projects self-serve instantly; keys in dashboard; management API PAT self-serve.
breadth: Auto REST (PostgREST) per project + Storage/Auth admin + management API (projects, branches)

name: Datadog
does: Cloud observability platform (metrics, logs, traces, monitors).
